papers.title: Elucidating the Design Space of LM Data Attribution
papers.translated_title: 阐明语言模型数据归因的设计空间
papers.author: Steven Yu
papers.summary: Data attribution methods for Language Models (LMs) are typically evaluated using downstream tasks like fact retrieval. However, existing evaluations vary multiple dataset properties simultaneously, making it impossible to isolate exactly why an attribution algorithm fails. To diagnose these failures, we explore the design space of LLM data attribution, with a primary focus on evaluation. We introduce the Controlled Attribution Benchmark (CATT) for fact tracing, in which we fine-tune LLMs on entirely fictitious knowledge, providing unambiguous ground truth for attribution. This synthetic setup allows us to systematically alter one dataset configuration at a time, such as document redundancy and lexical distractors. With this configurable evaluation, we demonstrate that redundancy and distractors consistently degrade attribution performance. Rather than proposing a new estimator, we examine two design choices that are underexplored: the loss used to compute gradients and how per-token attribution scores are aggregated into a document score. We find that the true causal evidence within a training document is highly localized, but standard methods dilute this evidence into noise by averaging attribution scores across the entire document. We find that replacing standard cross-entropy loss gradients with the negative log-odds gradients surfaces the critical tokens from other uninformative ones. We can then aggregate only the top token scores to improve ground truth recall by 35 to 72 percentage points across multiple baselines on our diagnostic benchmark. The negative log-odds correction also generalizes to FTRACE-TREX, improving counterfactual retraining performance for every method we test, by up to 4.9x.
papers.translated_summary: 语言模型（LM）的数据归因方法通常通过事实检索等下游任务进行评估。然而，现有评估同时改变多个数据集属性，导致无法准确判断归因算法失败的原因。为诊断这些失败，我们探索了LLM数据归因的设计空间，主要聚焦于评估。我们引入了用于事实追踪的受控归因基准（CATT），在其中我们在完全虚构的知识上微调LLM，为归因提供明确的真实标签。这一合成设置使我们能够系统地一次改变一个数据集配置，例如文档冗余和词汇干扰项。借助这一可配置的评估，我们证明冗余和干扰项会持续降低归因性能。我们没有提出新的估计器，而是考察了两个尚未充分探索的设计选择：用于计算梯度的损失函数，以及如何将逐token归因分数聚合为文档分数。我们发现训练文档中真正的因果证据高度局部化，但标准方法通过对整个文档的归因分数取平均，将这一证据稀释为噪声。我们发现，用负对数几率梯度替换标准交叉熵损失梯度，能够从其他无信息token中凸显关键token。然后我们可以仅聚合排名最高的token分数，在我们的诊断基准上，跨多个基线将真实标签召回率提升35至72个百分点。负对数几率校正还可推广到FTRACE-TREX，在我们测试的每种方法上改善反事实重训练性能，最高提升4.9倍。

papers.title: Propose-Filter-Release: Scaling Noise to Typical Sensitivity via Private Filtering
papers.translated_title: 提出-过滤-释放：通过私有过滤将噪声缩放至典型敏感度
papers.author: Moshe Shenfeld
papers.summary: An estimator can be accurate and stable on typical data, yet sensitive to a few possible records. Differentially private mechanisms commonly scale their noise to the worst-case influence of a single record, which lets these records dictate the noise even when the remaining data would allow far less. Removing them first would restore the smaller scale, but the removal must itself be private. We introduce \emph{propose-filter-release} (PFR), which, by privately filtering its input, turns a mechanism that protects the addition or removal of a typical record, one that fits the remaining data, into one that is differentially private in the standard sense, on every input. Using our novel filtering step, PFR requires only a concave friendliness score, which measures how well a record fits a dataset, and a release mechanism that is friendly-DP, that is, private when the changed record fits the remaining data. For every such score and release mechanism, it guarantees differential privacy under public conditions on the number of records, so it is a general privacy primitive, comparable to propose-test-release, and FriendlyCore can be viewed as one of its implementations. We illustrate the generality of PFR by instantiating it for scalar statistics, principal subspace estimation, the KL divergence of user histograms, the effective resistances of a graph, and treatment-rule selection.
papers.translated_summary: 一个估计器在典型数据上可能既准确又稳定，却对少数可能的记录敏感。差分隐私机制通常将噪声缩放到单条记录的最坏情况影响，这使得这些记录决定了噪声水平，即使其余数据本可允许远更小的噪声。先移除这些记录可以恢复较小的噪声规模，但移除过程本身必须是隐私的。我们提出\emph{提议-过滤-发布}（PFR），它通过隐私地过滤其输入，将一个保护典型记录增删、且适配剩余数据的机制，转变为在标准意义上对每个输入都满足差分隐私的机制。利用我们新颖的过滤步骤，PFR仅需要一个凹的友好性评分，用以衡量一条记录与数据集的契合程度，以及一个友好差分隐私的发布机制，即在被改变记录与剩余数据契合时满足隐私。对于每个这样的评分和发布机制，它在关于记录数量的公开条件下保证差分隐私，因此它是一种通用的隐私原语，可与提议-测试-发布相媲美，而FriendlyCore可视为其实现之一。我们通过为标量统计量、主子空间估计、用户直方图的KL散度、图的有效电阻以及处理规则选择实例化PFR，来说明其通用性。

papers.title: Micro-Edits: Computational Support for Fine-Scale Edits in Film
papers.translated_title: 微剪辑：电影中精细剪辑的计算支持
papers.author: Nhan Tran
papers.summary: In film editing, every frame matters. While macro, content-level edits shape the high-level narrative of a film, small local edits often control timing and direct visual attention. For example, editors can adjust the precise timing of clips to control the length of a meaningful silence, or cut to shots that highlight a specific character's reactions to important moments. These small, detailed edits are slow and tedious to make in standard editing tools because users have to map high-level narrative goals to low-level frame-by-frame adjustments. At the same time, these fine-scale adjustments, which we call micro-edits, can be nuanced and expressive, with different choices serving different creative goals. In this work, we start by conducting a formative study with professional editors to understand the structure of micro-edits and how they are used. We then derive a mathematical formalization for this structure to develop tools that leverage AI and optimization to make exploring micro-edits simpler and more efficient for users. Finally, we validate our tools in multiple user studies and a wide range of video examples.
papers.translated_summary: 在电影剪辑中，每一帧都至关重要。虽然宏观的内容层面剪辑塑造了电影的高层叙事，但微小的局部剪辑往往控制着节奏并引导视觉注意力。例如，剪辑师可以调整片段的精确时间来控制一段有意义的静默的长度，或者切换到突出某个角色对重要时刻反应的镜头。这些微小而精细的剪辑在标准剪辑工具中制作起来缓慢而繁琐，因为用户必须将高层叙事目标映射到低层的逐帧调整。与此同时，这些我们称之为微剪辑的精细尺度调整可以细腻而富有表现力，不同的选择服务于不同的创作目标。在这项工作中，我们首先与专业剪辑师进行了一项形成性研究，以理解微剪辑的结构及其使用方式。然后，我们推导出该结构的数学形式化表述，以开发利用人工智能和优化来使用户探索微剪辑更简单、更高效的工具。最后，我们在多项用户研究和广泛的视频示例中验证了我们的工具。

papers.title: Rethinking Neural Thickets Without Weight Perturbations
papers.translated_title: 重新思考无权重扰动的神经丛林
papers.author: Nicolas Dufour
papers.summary: The Neural Thickets hypothesis posits that pretrained language models lie in dense neighborhoods of task-specific experts in weight space, which random Gaussian perturbations can uncover. We reproduce the reported gains, but show that they do not require this geometric explanation. Perturbing a single decoder block already recovers much of the improvement, while keeping the model entirely frozen and adding a random bias to its output logits matches or exceeds full-weight perturbations on most reasoning tasks. This suggests an alternative explanation based on output diversity, validation-based selection, and voting. We formalize this view as Perturb-Select-Vote (PSV), a general procedure that generates perturbed predictors, selects high-performing members on a small validation set, and aggregates their predictions. This interpretation connects Neural Thickets to established inference-time methods, including sampling, self-consistency, and verifier-guided selection. A first-order analysis further shows that small weight perturbations act primarily through their induced logit shifts. We extend this analysis to vision, where logit PSV substantially improves performance under domain shift, including on Earth observation, while full-weight perturbations provide little additional benefit. Together, these results suggest that the gains attributed to nearby weight-space experts can instead be obtained through output diversity, selection, and voting. Logit PSV realizes these benefits with a fully frozen model, providing a simple, training-free alternative to full-weight perturbation ensembles across language and vision.
papers.translated_summary: Neural Thickets 假说认为，预训练语言模型位于权重空间中任务特定专家的密集邻域内，而随机高斯扰动可以揭示这些专家。我们复现了所报告的增益，但表明这些增益并不需要这一几何解释。仅扰动单个解码器块就已能恢复大部分改进，而在模型完全冻结并对其输出 logits 添加随机偏置的情况下，在大多数推理任务上可匹配或超过全权重扰动。这表明一种基于输出多样性、基于验证的选择和投票的替代解释。我们将这一观点形式化为 Perturb-Select-Vote（PSV），一种通用流程：生成受扰动的预测器，在小验证集上选择表现优异的成员，并聚合其预测。这一解释将 Neural Thickets 与既有的推理时方法联系起来，包括采样、自一致性和验证器引导的选择。一阶分析进一步表明，小幅权重扰动主要通过其诱导的 logit 偏移起作用。我们将这一分析扩展到视觉领域，其中 logit PSV 在域偏移下显著提升性能，包括在地球观测任务上，而全权重扰动几乎不提供额外收益。总之，这些结果表明，归因于邻近权重空间专家的增益反而可以通过输出多样性、选择和投票获得。Logit PSV 在完全冻结模型的情况下实现了这些收益，为跨语言和视觉的全权重扰动集成提供了一种简单、无需训练的替代方案。

papers.title: Read, Allocate, Route: Role-Coupled Tokenization for Pixel-Space Generative Transformers
papers.translated_title: 阅读、分配、路由：面向像素空间生成式Transformer的角色耦合分词
papers.author: Jiongfan Yang
papers.summary: Pixel-space generative Transformers typically use one token per image patch, so capturing finer detail requires more tokens and makes global attention increasingly expensive. We observe that finer detail does not necessarily require more global communication: low-frequency structure benefits from global exchange, while high-frequency detail can be modeled locally. Based on this insight, we introduce SpecSlot, a pixel-space rectified-flow Transformer that decouples output detail from the length of the global attention sequence. SpecSlot expands each spatial anchor into multiple slots, each assigned a disjoint band of DCT coefficients; this separates anchor density from spectral subdivision. Only the lowest-frequency slot from each anchor participates in global attention, while all slots interact locally. This allows the model to increase spectral detail without enlarging the global sequence. A spatial head further adds a local correction to the spectral prediction, while the generative state, target, and loss remain in pixel space. On ImageNet-256, SpecSlot achieves a comparable final FID to a FLOPs-matched JiT control while converging faster. On ImageNet-512, it improves FID by 2.84 over the control with 3.9% fewer FLOPs, and comes within only 0.69 FID of JiT-B/16 at 38.2% lower cost. On text-to-image generation, SpecSlot surpasses JiT-B/8 on DPG-Bench by 1.06 at 40.6% lower forward cost.
papers.translated_summary: 像素空间生成式 Transformer 通常对每个图像块使用一个 token，因此捕捉更精细的细节需要更多 token，并使全局注意力的开销日益增大。我们观察到，更精细的细节并不必然需要更多的全局通信：低频结构受益于全局交换，而高频细节可以在局部建模。基于这一洞见，我们提出 SpecSlot，一种像素空间 rectified-flow Transformer，它将输出细节与全局注意力序列的长度解耦。SpecSlot 将每个空间锚点扩展为多个槽位，每个槽位分配一组不相交的 DCT 系数频带；这将锚点密度与频谱细分分离。每个锚点仅最低频的槽位参与全局注意力，而所有槽位在局部交互。这使得模型能够在不扩大全局序列的情况下增加频谱细节。一个空间头进一步对频谱预测添加局部修正，同时生成状态、目标和损失仍保持在像素空间。在 ImageNet-256 上，SpecSlot 在收敛更快的同时，取得了与 FLOPs 匹配的 JiT 对照模型相当的最终 FID。在 ImageNet-512 上，它以少 3.9% 的 FLOPs 将 FID 相对对照模型提升 2.84，并以低 38.2% 的成本将差距缩小到仅比 JiT-B/16 差 0.69 FID。在文本到图像生成上，SpecSlot 在 DPG-Bench 上以低 40.6% 的前向成本超越 JiT-B/8 达 1.06。

papers.title: Adaptive Scenario Generation for KL-DRO Around a Learned Density Model
papers.translated_title: 围绕学习密度模型的自适应场景生成用于KL-DRO
papers.author: Aron Brenner
papers.summary: Distributionally robust optimization (DRO) hedges data-driven two-stage stochastic programs against error in the distribution estimated from a finite record, and standard ambiguity sets differ in how they treat realizations absent from that record. A divergence ball around the empirical distribution contains only reweightings of the record, whereas a transport ball also contains distributions supported off the record, including on realizations the data-generating process cannot produce, against which the decision is then hedged as well. We instead propose a Kullback-Leibler (KL) ball centered at a density model fitted to the record, the learned nominal, which lets the adversary up-weight costly unobserved realizations in proportion to the probability the model assigns them. Solving the resulting problem poses a second difficulty, because it can accommodate only a few scenarios, and an independent sample of that size is likely to omit the rare realizations on which the worst case concentrates. We therefore build the scenario set adaptively, alternating between solving the finite problem and drawing new realizations from the learned nominal, steered toward the worst case at the current decision, with importance weights that correct the draws back to the model. On a multi-item newsvendor problem and a capacity expansion problem on realistic grid data, centering the ball at the learned nominal rather than at the record lowers cost under distribution shift, at comparable in-distribution cost, when the record is scarce and the model class captures structure that lets it extrapolate beyond the record. The advantage fades as the record grows or as the shift departs from the structure the model has learned.
papers.translated_summary: 分布鲁棒优化（DRO）为数据驱动的两阶段随机规划提供保障，以抵御从有限记录中估计出的分布存在的误差，而标准歧义集在处理该记录中未出现的实现值时各有不同。围绕经验分布的散度球仅包含对记录的重新加权，而传输球还包含支撑在记录之外的分布，包括在数据生成过程无法产生的实现值上的分布，决策随后也要针对这些分布进行对冲。我们转而提出一个以拟合到该记录的密度模型为中心的Kullback-Leibler（KL）球，即学习到的名义分布，它让对手能够按照模型赋予这些实现值的概率成比例地提高代价高昂的未观测实现值的权重。求解由此产生的问题构成第二个困难，因为它只能容纳少量情景，而该规模的独立样本很可能遗漏最坏情况所集中的稀有实现值。因此，我们自适应地构建情景集，在求解有限问题与从学习到的名义分布中抽取新实现值之间交替进行，抽取过程朝向当前决策下的最坏情况引导，并使用重要性权重将抽取结果校正回该模型。在一个多物品报童问题和一个基于真实电网数据的容量扩展问题上，当记录稀缺且模型类能够捕捉使其外推到记录之外的结构时，将球心设在学习到的名义分布而非记录上，可在分布偏移下降低成本，而分布内成本相当。当记录增长或偏移偏离模型已学习到的结构时，这一优势会减弱。

papers.title: Luggage re-identification: A study of strategies towards a real-world application
papers.translated_title: 行李再识别：面向实际应用策略的研究
papers.author: Quentin Dhôte
papers.summary: Luggage re-identification (ReID) is a critical task in video surveillance for forensics, security or border management (suspicious or abandoned luggage recognition), as well as luggage management (lost luggage recovery). It enables the association of observations of the same luggage across disjoint camera views in complex environments such as airports, train stations and border crossing. While existing approaches primarily focus on appearance-based cropped image matching under relatively clean conditions, real-world scenarios are characterized by frequent occlusions, cluttered background and crowded scenes which significantly degrade performance. Yet, strategies leveraging the complementarity of multiple shots and views from different video streams is overlooked. In this paper, we study strategies for an end-to-end pipeline that operates from multiple video streams to detect and re-identify luggage. We evaluate different variants on a benchmark dataset acquired in real-world environments to address the questions of selecting and merging different views and shots of the same luggage as well as training on different environment datasets for an overall ReID performance improvement in practical applications.
papers.translated_summary: 行李重识别（ReID）是视频监控中的一项关键任务，适用于取证、安全或边境管理（可疑或遗留行李识别）以及行李管理（丢失行李找回）。它能够在机场、火车站和边境口岸等复杂环境中，将同一行李在不相交摄像机视图中的观测进行关联。现有方法主要关注在相对干净条件下基于外观的裁剪图像匹配，而现实场景的特点是频繁遮挡、背景杂乱和场景拥挤，这些会显著降低性能。然而，利用来自不同视频流的多张图像和多视图互补性的策略却被忽视了。本文研究了从多个视频流进行检测和重识别行李的端到端流程策略。我们在真实环境获取的基准数据集上评估了不同变体，以解决如何选择和合并同一行李的不同视图与图像，以及在不同环境数据集上训练以在实际应用中整体提升ReID性能的问题。

papers.title: From extreme weather to agricultural consequences with agentic AI
papers.translated_title: 从极端天气到农业后果，借助代理式人工智能
papers.author: Minghan Yu
papers.summary: Extreme weather is forecast days ahead, yet its consequences for agriculture remain hard to predict: a forecast says where a storm will strike, not which crops will suffer or how much is at risk, and the records that could tell span many sources. We present WxCrop, the first agent that judges agricultural hazards from physically interpretable weather indices examined by causal analysis, and the first that combines weather and agricultural information to predict crop loss reliably for past and forecast dates. We demonstrate it in Florida on hurricanes, freezes and dry heat, with a loss model calibrated on insurance records for each, and the same procedure extends to other hazards and areas. Three checks show reliability: the hurricane index detects recorded cyclone days with an AUC of 0.98, recorded losses in held-out years are reproduced to within 2%, and independent production records confirm the county rankings (rank correlation 0.63). Users ask the agent for each crop group's loss as a fraction of expected season value, every number sourced, so that governments, growers and scientists respond to agricultural disasters quickly.
papers.translated_summary: 极端天气可提前数天预报，但其对农业的影响仍难以预测：预报只能说明风暴将袭击何处，却无法说明哪些作物会受损、风险有多大，而可提供线索的记录分散在众多来源中。我们提出WxCrop，这是首个通过因果分析检验物理可解释天气指数来判断农业灾害的智能体，也是首个结合天气与农业信息、对过去和预报日期可靠预测作物损失的智能体。我们在佛罗里达州以飓风、冰冻和干热为例进行演示，每种灾害的损失模型均依据保险记录校准，同一流程可推广至其他灾害和地区。三项检验表明其可靠性：飓风指数识别有记录的气旋日，AUC达0.98；在留出年份中，有记录的损失复现误差在2%以内；独立生产记录证实了县排名（秩相关0.63）。用户可向该智能体查询各作物组损失占预期季节产值的比例，每个数字均有来源，从而使政府、种植者和科学家能够快速应对农业灾害。

papers.title: SonoWorld4D: From One Video to a 4D Audio-Visual Scene via Diffusion Synchronization
papers.translated_title: SonoWorld4D：通过扩散同步从单段视频生成4D视听场景
papers.author: Derong Jin
papers.summary: Recent progress in visual scene generation has extended beyond static 3D scenes toward the more challenging problem of generating dynamic 4D scenes from minimal input. However, sound, despite being intrinsically coupled with dynamic objects and events, remains largely unmodeled in prior work. We introduce Video-to-4DAVScene, a new task that turns a video into an explorable, time-varying 4D audio-visual scene, and present the SonoWorld4D framework for this task. Given a monocular video, our method generates a 360 static background, reconstructs explicit motion trajectories of dynamic, sound-emitting foreground objects, and synthesizes a physically-grounded sound field consistent across multiple sources through dual-space audio diffusion synchronization. The resulting 4D scene supports real-time novel-view visual and spatial audio rendering. Evaluation on real-world dynamic scenes and a user study demonstrates SonoWorld4D generates 4D audio-visual scenes with perceptually realistic, physically grounded spatial audio consistent with scene geometry and visual content.
papers.translated_summary: 视觉场景生成的最新进展已超越静态3D场景，转向从最少输入生成动态4D场景这一更具挑战性的问题。然而，声音尽管与动态对象和事件内在耦合，在先前工作中仍基本未被建模。我们提出Video-to-4DAVScene，一项将视频转化为可探索、随时间变化的4D视听场景的新任务，并为此提出SonoWorld4D框架。给定单目视频，我们的方法生成360度静态背景，重建动态、发声前景对象的显式运动轨迹，并通过双空间音频扩散同步合成跨多个声源物理一致的声音场。所得4D场景支持实时新视角视觉与空间音频渲染。在真实世界动态场景上的评估和一项用户研究表明，SonoWorld4D生成的4D视听场景具有感知真实、物理一致且与场景几何和视觉内容相符的空间音频。

papers.title: world2vec: Mechanistic world models through latent dynamics learning
papers.translated_title: world2vec：通过潜在动力学学习构建的机制性世界模型
papers.author: Tobias Schmidt
papers.summary: World models can achieve strong control performance without faithfully capturing the dynamics of their environment, limiting their potential for mechanistic interpretability and scientific discovery. Here, we introduce world2vec to learn mechanistic world models without reward information directly from observations and actions. World2vec learns latent dynamics that faithfully reproduce the true system over long prediction horizons, with at least one order of magnitude fewer parameters than DreamerV3, TD-MPC2 and LeWM. This enables state of the art performance in controlling continuous environments from pixels and accurate system identification across a benchmark of 71 attractors, demonstrating how world models are amenable to scientific discovery.
papers.translated_summary: 世界模型可以在不忠实捕捉环境动力学的情况下实现强大的控制性能，这限制了它们在机制可解释性和科学发现方面的潜力。在此，我们引入world2vec，直接从观测和动作中学习无需奖励信息的机制世界模型。world2vec学习潜在动力学，能够在长预测时域上忠实再现真实系统，且参数量至少比DreamerV3、TD-MPC2和LeWM少一个数量级。这使得从像素控制连续环境达到最先进性能，并在71个吸引子基准上实现准确的系统识别，展示了世界模型如何适用于科学发现。

papers.title: Chronic unpredictable stress induces negative cognitive bias in rats with sex-specific changes in neurogenesis and functional connectivity
papers.translated_title: 慢性不可预测应激诱导大鼠产生负性认知偏差，并伴随神经发生和功能连接的性别特异性变化
papers.author: Namchuk, A. B.
papers.summary: Background: Females are more likely to be diagnosed with major depressive disorder (MDD) than males. Cognitive symptoms of MDD include negative cognitive bias, the perception of ambiguous situations as negative, which predicts MDD episode onset and severity. MDD is associated with changes to functional connectivity between regions involved in cognition, emotion, attention, and memory. Methods: Here we examined the impact of chronic unpredictable stress (CUS) on negative cognitive bias in male (n=18) and female (n=22) Sprague-Dawley rats. We assessed hippocampal neurogenesis and c-Fos expression in response to an ambiguous context across 15 regions of the frontal cortex, amygdala, nucleus accumbens, and hippocampus, including in newborn dentate gyrus (DG) neurons, to examine functional connectivity during cognitive bias testing. We conducted a graph-based network analysis and constructed linear models to predict freezing in the ambiguous context based on regional activation. Results: CUS-exposed rats froze more to the ambiguous context than non-CUS-exposed rats, regardless of sex. CUS decreased neurogenesis in the ventral DG of both sexes, and increased activation of new neurons in the dorsal DG of males only. In response to the ambiguous context, CUS males had an increase in c-Fos expression in the amygdala. CUS produced extensive, sex-specific network reorganization, decreasing global network efficiency in males but not in females. Freezing in the ambiguous context was predicted by activation of new neurons in combination with the ventral CA1 in opposing directions across sex. Conclusions: These findings suggest that sex-specific pathways drive the expression of CUS-induced negative cognitive bias, underscoring the necessity of sex-stratified preclinical and clinical research on negative cognitive bias in depression.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：女性比男性更有可能被诊断出重度抑郁症（MDD）。MDD的认知症状包括负性认知偏向，即对模糊情境作负性感知，这种偏向可预测MDD发作的起始与严重程度。MDD与涉及认知、情绪、注意和记忆的脑区之间功能连接的变化有关。方法：本研究考察了慢性不可预测应激（CUS）对雄性（n=18）和雌性（n=22）Sprague-Dawley大鼠负性认知偏向的影响。我们评估了海马神经发生以及面对模糊情境时c-Fos的表达，覆盖额叶皮层、杏仁核、伏隔核和海马的15个区域，包括新生齿状回（DG）神经元，以考察认知偏向测试期间的功能连接。我们进行了基于图的网络分析，并构建线性模型以根据区域激活预测模糊情境中的僵直行为。结果：无论性别，暴露于CUS的大鼠比未暴露于CUS的大鼠在模糊情境中僵直更多。CUS降低了两种性别腹侧DG的神经发生，并且仅在雄性中增加了背侧DG新生神经元的激活。面对模糊情境时，CUS雄性杏仁核中c-Fos表达增加。CUS产生了广泛的、性别特异性的网络重组，降低了雄性而非雌性的全局网络效率。模糊情境中的僵直行为可由新生神经元激活与腹侧CA1的激活共同预测，且两者在不同性别中作用方向相反。结论：这些发现表明，性别特异性通路驱动了CUS诱导的负性认知偏向的表达，凸显了在抑郁症负性认知偏向研究中进行按性别分层的临床前和临床研究的必要性。

papers.title: MRI-free OPM-MEG recovers medial temporal lobe theta during scene imagination
papers.translated_title: 无MRI的OPM-MEG在场景想象中恢复内侧颞叶θ波
papers.author: Thornberry, C.
papers.summary: Optically pumped magnetometer magnetoencephalography (OPM-MEG) offers a wearable, movement-tolerant alternative to conventional cryogenic MEG, placing sensors closer to the scalp and, in principle, improving sensitivity to deep sources. This is advantageous for examining subcortical structures that are affected by ageing, disorders and disease, such as the hippocampus. However, it remains unclear whether well-established activity (such as the attenuation of theta oscillations during the imagination of novel scenes) can be recovered from the medial temporal lobe (MTL) with OPM-MEG, and whether an individual structural MRI is required. Here, fifteen adults completed a scene imagination task. Initially we applied a 12-parameter template warping coregistration pipeline to the full sample. Following source reconstruction, we recovered the expected attenuation of theta (4-8 Hz) power during scene imagination compared to a counting baseline, with a significant cluster of activity peaking in the left parahippocampal gyrus. The clusters centre of mass was localised to the left hippocampus (t = -3.55, p = 0.048, whole-brain FWE-corrected) and was mostly confined to the left medial temporal lobe. We further supported our findings by using an individual T1-weighted MRI reconstruction pipeline in six participants who had these scans available. The two approaches produced similar whole-brain topographies and localised the peak MTL theta effect to left hippocampus, with temporal-lobe conjunction centroids 3-mm apart. These findings provide evidence that the theta attenuation of the scene construction network can be recovered at the group level with OPM-MEG, without an individual MRI.
papers.translated_summary: 光学泵浦磁力计脑磁图（OPM-MEG）为传统低温脑磁图提供了一种可穿戴、耐运动的替代方案，将传感器放置得更靠近头皮，原则上提高了对深部源的敏感性。这对于研究受衰老、障碍和疾病影响的皮层下结构（如海马）具有优势。然而，目前尚不清楚能否用OPM-MEG从中颞叶（MTL）恢复出成熟的活动（例如想象新场景时θ振荡的衰减），以及是否需要个体结构MRI。在此，十五名成年人完成了一项场景想象任务。最初，我们对全样本应用了12参数模板配准核心配准流程。在源重建之后，我们恢复了场景想象相较于计数基线时预期的θ（4-8 Hz）功率衰减，在左侧海马旁回出现了一个显著的活动簇峰值。该簇的质心定位于左侧海马（t = -3.55，p = 0.048，全脑FWE校正），且主要局限于左侧中颞叶。我们进一步通过在有这些扫描数据的六名参与者中使用个体T1加权MRI重建流程来支持我们的发现。两种方法产生了相似的全脑地形图，并将MTL θ效应的峰值定位于左侧海马，颞叶联合质心相距3毫米。这些发现提供了证据，表明场景构建网络的θ衰减可以在组水平上用OPM-MEG恢复，而无需个体MRI。

papers.title: Conserved Laminar-Cellular Architecture Predicts the Spectrolaminar Motif
papers.translated_title: 保守的层状细胞构筑预测光谱层状基序
papers.author: Mulvey, A. G.
papers.summary: We recently identified the spectrolaminar motif, a layer-resolved pattern of local field potential (LFP) power, which is preserved across many areas of the primate cortex. It remains unclear which specific cytoarchitectonic features can explain the spectrolaminar motif. To investigate this, we performed histological and neurophysiological analyses of 11 brain areas spanning the macaque cortical hierarchy to examine the relationship between the laminar patterns of LFP power and the laminar distributions of cellular density for parvalbumin, calbindin, and calretinin interneurons, and pyramidal neurons. We tested whether cellular distributions are conserved and if they predict the corresponding variation in LFP power comprising the spectrolaminar motif. We found that the cytoarchitectonic and spectrolaminar data were intrinsically low-dimensional, with two-component patterns conserved across areas, and that the spectrolaminar motif could be predicted from these laminar cellular gradients. Critically, the regression coefficients mapping structure (cytoarchitecture) to function (spectrolaminar motif) were themselves highly conserved across areas, suggesting that a common cellular-to-spectral rule operates throughout cortex rather than a distinct rule per region. To evaluate this structure-function model, we tested it against post-mortem data from schizophrenia patients. We tested whether empirically-observed cytoarchitectonic changes from postmortem studies on inhibitory interneuron dysfunction in schizophrenia could be used to predict spectrolaminar alterations using our structure-function model. We found that they did, and that the functional changes match what is known from non-invasive neurophysiology in schizophrenia. This work moves beyond simple structure-function correlation to establish a predictive mathematical framework that informs healthy and aberrant brain circuitry.
papers.translated_summary: 我们最近识别出光谱层状基序，这是一种局部场电位（LFP）功率的层分辨模式，在灵长类皮层的许多区域中得以保留。目前尚不清楚哪些具体的细胞构筑特征能够解释光谱层状基序。为了研究这一问题，我们对跨越猕猴皮层等级体系的11个脑区进行了组织学和神经生理学分析，以考察LFP功率的层状模式与小白蛋白、钙结合蛋白和钙视网膜蛋白中间神经元以及锥体神经元的细胞密度层状分布之间的关系。我们检验了细胞分布是否保守，以及它们是否能预测构成光谱层状基序的LFP功率的相应变化。我们发现，细胞构筑和光谱层状数据本质上是低维的，双组分模式在各区域间保守，并且光谱层状基序可以从这些层状细胞梯度中预测。关键的是，将结构（细胞构筑）映射到功能（光谱层状基序）的回归系数本身在各区域间高度保守，这表明整个皮层运作着一个共同的细胞到光谱规则，而非每个区域有各自的独立规则。为了评估这一结构-功能模型，我们将其与精神分裂症患者的死后数据进行了检验。我们检验了利用我们的结构-功能模型，能否用精神分裂症抑制性中间神经元功能障碍的死后研究中实际观察到的细胞构筑变化来预测光谱层状改变。我们发现确实可以，并且功能变化与精神分裂症非侵入性神经生理学的已知结果相符。这项工作超越了简单的结构-功能相关性，建立了一个预测性数学框架，为健康和异常脑环路提供了信息。

papers.title: Fixel-wise Differences in White Matter Fiber-bundle Cross-section identified in Children who Stutter
papers.translated_title: 口吃儿童中白质纤维束横截面的体素级差异
papers.author: Weerathunge, H.
papers.summary: Developmental stuttering has been repeatedly linked to decreased white matter integrity and structural connectivity differences in major white matter tracts. Prior diffusion-weighted MRI studies reporting such white matter structural differences involved voxel-averaged tensor measures (e.g., fractional anisotropy (FA)). A well-acknowledged limitation of this approach, however, has been that it cannot resolve distinct fiber populations within crossing-fiber regions. Fixel-based analysis addresses this limitation by quantifying individual fiber populations within a voxel and providing complementary measures of fiber density (FD), fiber-bundle cross-section (FC), and their combined measure (FDC).Here we applied Fixel-based analysis to diffusion MRI data from 171 children aged 3 - 13 years, including 84 children who stutter and 87 typically developing controls, to test whether white-matter differences associated with developmental stuttering were expressed as differences in FD, FC, and FDC and whether these measures show group-specific age-related patterns. We evaluated this at both the whole-brain level and within a priori white-matter tracts.FC, but not FD or FDC, showed significant Group and Group by Age effects, indicating that white-matter differences were primarily expressed in fiber-bundle macrostructure. Tract-of-interest analyses identified developmental differences in bilateral arcuate fasciculus FC that remained significant across tracts, with controls showing greater age-related increases in FC than children who stutter. Additional FC differences were observed across corticospinal and thalamocortical pathways, although these tract-wise effects were less robust to across-tract correction. These findings suggest that white-matter differences in developmental stuttering are prominently expressed in fiber-bundle macrostructure rather than fiber density and highlight divergent development of bilateral arcuate pathways. FBA provides fiber-specific information that complements conventional tensor-based diffusion measures and may improve characterization of white-matter development in childhood stuttering.
papers.translated_summary: 发育性口吃已被多次证实与主要白质纤维束的白质完整性下降和结构连接差异有关。先前报道此类白质结构差异的弥散加权MRI研究采用了体素平均张量指标（例如各向异性分数（FA））。然而，这种方法一个被广泛认可的局限性在于，它无法分辨交叉纤维区域内不同的纤维群体。基于纤维束元的分析通过量化体素内单个纤维群体并提供纤维密度（FD）、纤维束横截面（FC）及其联合指标（FDC）的互补测量，解决了这一局限性。在此，我们将基于纤维束元的分析应用于171名3至13岁儿童的弥散MRI数据，其中包括84名口吃儿童和87名典型发育对照，以检验与发育性口吃相关的白质差异是否表现为FD、FC和FDC的差异，以及这些指标是否显示出组别特异性的年龄相关模式。我们在全脑水平和先验白质纤维束内对此进行了评估。FC而非FD或FDC显示出显著的组别效应和组别×年龄效应，表明白质差异主要体现在纤维束宏观结构上。感兴趣纤维束分析识别出双侧弓状束FC的发育差异，该差异在各纤维束间保持显著，对照组FC的年龄相关增长大于口吃儿童。在皮质脊髓和丘脑皮质通路中还观察到额外的FC差异，尽管这些纤维束层面的效应在跨纤维束校正后不够稳健。这些发现表明，发育性口吃的白质差异显著体现在纤维束宏观结构而非纤维密度上，并突显了双侧弓状通路的差异性发育。FBA提供了纤维特异性信息，补充了传统的基于张量的弥散指标，并可能改善对儿童口吃白质发育的表征。

papers.title: Mitochondrial genome editing reveals the impact of complex I heteroplasmic variants on human neurogenesis
papers.translated_title: 线粒体基因组编辑揭示复合物I异质性变异对人类神经发生的影响
papers.author: Tolle, I.
papers.summary: Mitochondrial DNA (mtDNA) variants, whether maternally inherited or acquired somatically during aging, can be particularly detrimental to cells that rely on mitochondrial metabolism such as neurons. The functional consequences of mtDNA variants are thought to depend on their heteroplasmy, defined as the proportion of mtDNA molecules carrying that variant. However, investigating the specific effects of heteroplasmic mtDNA variants on human neuronal function has been challenging. Studies using patient-derived cells cannot conclusively attribute observed phenotypes to a single mtDNA variant, while conventional genome editing approaches are not applicable to mtDNA. Here, we use DddA-derived cytosine base editor (DdCBE) to introduce pathogenic heteroplasmic mtDNA variants into Neurogenin 2 (NGN2)-inducible human induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs). We focus on two variants in the genes MT-ND1 and MT-ND5 belonging to complex I (CI), the largest component of the mitochondrial respiratory chain and a frequent contributor to human disease, including the incurable neurodevelopmental disorder Leigh syndrome. mtDNA-edited iPSC lines exhibit low off-target editing and maintain similar heteroplasmy following subclonal isolation and differentiation into NGN2-induced neurons (iNs). Although the CI variants do not substantially affect mitochondrial energy metabolism in undifferentiated iPSCs, they reduce mitochondrial membrane potential in iNs where they drive a transcriptional reprogramming indicative of impaired neuronal commitment. These findings suggest that heteroplasmic CI variants are sufficient to disrupt neural fate specification even at relatively low heteroplasmy. More broadly, mtDNA editing in human iPSCs provides a powerful platform to investigate how mitochondrial fitness and heteroplasmy influence development and disease.
papers.translated_summary: 线粒体DNA（mtDNA）变异，无论是母系遗传还是在衰老过程中体细胞获得的，都可能对依赖线粒体代谢的细胞（如神经元）尤为有害。mtDNA变异的功能后果被认为取决于其异质性，即携带该变异的mtDNA分子所占比例。然而，研究异质性mtDNA变异对人类神经元功能的具体影响一直具有挑战性。使用患者来源细胞的研究无法将观察到的表型确凿地归因于单一mtDNA变异，而传统的基因组编辑方法不适用于mtDNA。在此，我们使用DddA衍生的胞嘧啶碱基编辑器（DdCBE）将致病性异质性mtDNA变异引入Neurogenin 2（NGN2）诱导型人类诱导多能干细胞（iPSCs）中。我们聚焦于MT-ND1和MT-ND5基因中的两个变异，这两个基因属于复合体I（CI），CI是线粒体呼吸链中最大的组分，也是人类疾病的常见诱因，包括无法治愈的神经发育障碍Leigh综合征。mtDNA编辑的iPSC系表现出低脱靶编辑，并在亚克隆分离和分化为NGN2诱导神经元（iNs）后维持相似的异质性。尽管CI变异在未分化iPSCs中未对线粒体能量代谢产生显著影响，但它们在iNs中降低了线粒体膜电位，并驱动了表明神经元定向受损的转录重编程。这些发现表明，异质性CI变异足以破坏神经命运特化，即使在相对较低的异质性水平下也是如此。更广泛地说，人类iPSCs中的mtDNA编辑为研究线粒体适应性和异质性如何影响发育和疾病提供了一个强大的平台。

papers.title: Desmin Mutations Disrupt Filament Elongation and Drive Polymorphic Aggregation
papers.translated_title: Desmin突变破坏纤维延伸并驱动多态性聚集
papers.author: Schween, L.
papers.summary: In muscle cells, desmin intermediate filaments form a cytoskeletal network that maintains the structural integrity and mechanical coupling of myofibrils. Dominant missense mutations in desmin cause myopathies characterized by intracellular protein aggregation. To explore the process of aggregate formation, we investigate the assembly kinetics of wild-type desmin and four disease-associated variants (N342D, L345P, R350P, and R406W) using dual-wavelength stopped-flow spectroscopy, complemented by atomic force microscopy and molecular dynamics simulations. At low ionic strength, all proteins form uniform tetramers. Increasing the ionic strength initiates assembly by rapid lateral association of tetramers into unit-length filaments (ULFs), followed by longitudinal elongation and radial filament compaction. R406W forms ULFs with wild-type-like kinetics, whereas N342D, L345P, and R350P exhibit delayed lateral assembly. After short filaments have formed, all four mutants diverge from productive filament maturation, but through distinct pathways. Quantitative analysis of atomic force microscopy images together with kinetic modelling of the spectroscopic data shows that wild-type filaments elongate continuously, whereas R406W filaments progressively associate into fibrillar clusters and cease elongating. By contrast, N342D, L345P, and R350P rapidly collapse into globular complexes that subsequently coalesce into larger aggregates. Molecular dynamics simulations indicate that the mutations differentially destabilize coil 2, which leads to local structural perturbations and mutation-specific assembly defects. Together, these findings identify early filament maturation - when elongating ULF-derived filaments would normally undergo radial compaction to form stable, mature filaments - as a critical time point in desmin assembly. At this stage, pathogenic mutations redirect the internal reorganization of the filament from productive stabilization toward mutation-specific structural collapse and aggregation.
papers.translated_summary: 在肌肉细胞中，结蛋白中间丝形成细胞骨架网络，维持肌原纤维的结构完整性和机械耦合。结蛋白的显性错义突变引起以细胞内蛋白质聚集为特征的肌病。为探究聚集形成的过程，我们利用双波长停流光谱法研究野生型结蛋白及四种疾病相关变体（N342D、L345P、R350P和R406W）的组装动力学，并辅以原子力显微镜和分子动力学模拟。在低离子强度下，所有蛋白质均形成均一的四聚体。提高离子强度后，组装启动，四聚体快速侧向缔合形成单位长度丝（ULFs），随后纵向延伸并径向丝致密化。R406W形成ULFs的动力学与野生型相似，而N342D、L345P和R350P表现出侧向组装延迟。短丝形成后，所有四种突变体均偏离有效的丝成熟过程，但通过不同途径。原子力显微镜图像的定量分析结合光谱数据的动力学建模表明，野生型丝持续延伸，而R406W丝逐渐缔合为纤维状簇并停止延伸。相比之下，N342D、L345P和R350P迅速塌缩为球状复合物，随后合并为更大的聚集体。分子动力学模拟表明，这些突变差异性地失稳卷曲2，导致局部结构扰动和突变特异性组装缺陷。总之，这些发现确定了早期丝成熟——即延伸的ULF衍生丝通常应经历径向致密化以形成稳定成熟丝的时期——是结蛋白组装的关键时间点。在此阶段，致病突变将丝的内部重组从有效的稳定化转向突变特异性结构塌缩和聚集。

papers.title: THERAPY RESISTANCE IN MELANOMA DRIVES CILIOGENESIS AND GLUTAMINE/ASPARTATE METABOLISM DEPENDENCY
papers.translated_title: 黑色素瘤的治疗耐药性驱动纤毛发生和谷氨酰胺/天冬氨酸代谢依赖性
papers.author: Lugato, P.
papers.summary: Despite the remarkable success of new therapeutic approaches, a considerable number of melanoma patients still relapse on conventional therapies within two years and develop resistance. Alterations in metabolism, including amino acid availability and regulation of metabolic processes, have been implicated in acquired drug resistance. In this study, we developed in vitro and in vivo models of target therapy resistance (TTR) and identified a translational program that supports primary ciliogenesis in drug-resistant BRAF melanoma. We established that drug resistance enhances primary ciliogenesis, which is needed to respond and survive to combination therapy (CT). Mechanistically, impairing cilia formation (IFT88KO) rewires glutamine and aspartate metabolism. Overall, we provide a new molecular mechanism underlying therapy resistance that should be considered to tailored therapeutic strategies.

papers.title: Rev-erb-alpha inhibits vascular calcification by repressing osteogenic reprogramming in atherosclerosis

papers.author: Ferri, L.
papers.summary: Background Atherosclerotic plaque rupture is the leading cause of fatal atherothrombotic events, including myocardial infarction. Intimal microcalcification is a major determinant of plaque instability, but its pathogenic mechanisms remain poorly understood. The nuclear receptor Rev-erb-alpha regulates lipoprotein metabolism and inflammation. We hypothesized that it modulates atherogenesis by also controlling arterial calcification. Methods To identify regulators of vascular calcification, transcriptomic analysis of CD14+CD16- monocytes from diabetic patients with different calcium scores (ANGIOSAFE cohort) was combined with targeted analysis in calcified and non-calcified atherosclerotic plaques from diabetic and non-diabetic patients (AtheroPortal cohort) and in calcified and non-calcified areas of human endarterectomies isolated by laser capture microdissection (OPAL Cohort). Functional relevance was evaluated in 18-month-old Ldlr-/- mouse and in primary aortic vascular smooth muscle cells after targeting Rev-erb-alpha. Results In ANGIOSAFE (n=668), REV-ERB-alpha expression was lower in classical CD14+CD16- monocytes from diabetic patients with low coronary artery calcium scores. In the AtheroPortal cohort (n=968), REV-ERB-alpha expression was reduced in highly calcified plaques from diabetic patients, and laser capture microdissection confirmed lower expression in calcified compared to non-calcified areas of human endarterectomies. Rev-erb alpha-deficient Ldlr-/- mice displayed accelerated atherogenesis and calcification, with SMCs reprogrammed toward an osteochondroblastic phenotype. In vitro, Rev-erb-alpha preserved SMC identity by repressing IL-1-beta-driven transdifferentiation, notably via Spp1, Osterix and Sox9, and repressed the hyaluronidase Cemip, whose activity degrades hyaluronic acid and promotes intimal calcification. Conclusions Rev-erb-alpha restrains SMC-driven vascular calcification by suppressing osteogenic reprogramming, and may represent a therapeutic target to reduce calcification and cardiovascular risk in high-risk patients.

papers.title: Reduced cerebral blood flow and metabolic rate trigger an adaptive mitochondrial remodeling program in a Down syndrome mouse model
papers.translated_title: 唐氏综合征小鼠模型中脑血流量和代谢率降低触发适应性线粒体重塑程序
papers.author: Saqib, M.
papers.summary: Mitochondrial dysfunction is a central feature of Down syndrome (DS), yet how trisomy 21 affects brain bioenergetics across scales--from gene transcription to cellular function to whole-brain metabolism--remains poorly understood. Here, we use the Dp16(1)Yey/+ (abbreviated Dp16) DS mouse model, which carries ~115 triplicated gene orthologs of human chromosome 21, to address this major knowledge gap and to provide direct in vivo evidence of brain-wide metabolic deficit in DS. Using magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) approaches, we show that Dp16 mice have reduced cerebral blood flow and metabolic rate of oxygen, with effects more pronounced in males than in females. Despite the suppression of cerebral metabolic rate, mitochondrial respiratory capacity and ATP synthase activity are largely preserved across brain regions, with sex differences noted. Transcriptomic analyses reveal marked upregulation of mitochondrial OXPHOS genes and the convergence of biological pathways related to proteostasis and mitochondrial function across brain regions, with male cortex and female cerebellum showing the biggest change. Collectively, our data suggest that a brain-wide metabolic deficit in Dp16 mice triggers an adaptive mitochondrial remodeling program across the brain to support bioenergetic demands. This compensatory response, however, is insufficient to normalize the metabolic dysfunction in Dp16 mice. Our findings underscore the value of integrating functional assessments at the organismal and tissue levels with transcriptomic changes to gain a systems view of physiologic perturbations and adaptations in the DS brain which may influence phenotypic outcomes.

papers.title: Tetradic Dynamics of Dyadic Sensorimotor Coordination: A Multiscale EEG Hyperscanning Study
papers.translated_title: 双人感觉运动协调的四元动力学：一项多尺度脑电超扫描研究
papers.author: Olarewaju, E.
papers.summary: How do leader and follower roles shape the brain mechanisms that support coordinated action between people? This question has therapeutic relevance for conditions such as schizophrenia and autism spectrum disorder, where the capacity for reciprocal social coordination is a defining vulnerability. Here, we propose a tetradic framework and examine sensorimotor coordination in 16 healthy adult pairs (15 included in EEG analyses) using dual-brain EEG hyperscanning and a 2x2 within-subject design crossing Role (Leader/Follower) and Condition (Mirroring/Matching). Mirroring required resonance with a partner's movement; Matching required its controlled transformation. This contrast was designed to dissociate automatic from controlled coordination. Behaviourally, Mirroring produced a robust Follower reaction-time advantage: pooling an independent behavioural-only cohort (combined N=64) revealed a smaller Leader advantage, consistent with role-dependent attention-inhibition gating. At the neural level, tonic power and significant phasic condition clusters were greater during Matching than Mirroring, while role-dependent phasic clusters suggested an anticipatory sequence around Leader responses and post-response gating and rebound around Follower responses. Information-theoretic decomposition identified Leader-unique predictive information in superior temporal regions and a separate frontal-pole interaction, Follower-unique predictive information in insular and superior frontal regions, sparse Synergy in the right rostral anterior cingulate cortex, and Redundancy spanning multiple cortical regions. These findings characterize tetradic coordination within dyads as a multiscale, role-asymmetric architecture in which top-down predictive control and bottom-up adaptive regulation are functionally dissociable. The tetradic framework provides a scaffold for this dissociation, and the role-specific signatures it reveals may offer candidate biomarkers for clinical populations in whom interpersonal coordination is disrupted.
papers.translated_summary: 领导者和追随者角色如何塑造支撑人际协调行动的大脑机制？这一问题对精神分裂症和自闭症谱系障碍等疾病具有治疗相关性，在这些疾病中，互惠社会协调能力是定义性的脆弱环节。在此，我们提出一个四元框架，并使用双脑EEG超扫描和2x2被试内设计（交叉角色：领导者/追随者与条件：镜像/匹配），考察16对健康成人（其中15对纳入EEG分析）的感觉运动协调。镜像要求与伙伴的运动产生共振；匹配要求对其运动进行受控转换。这一对比旨在分离自动协调与受控协调。在行为层面，镜像产生了稳健的追随者反应时优势：合并一个独立的行为-only队列（合并N=64）后，显示出较小的领导者优势，这与角色依赖的注意-抑制门控一致。在神经层面，匹配期间的强直功率和显著相位条件簇均大于镜像，而角色依赖的相位簇提示领导者反应前后存在预期序列，追随者反应前后存在反应后门控与反弹。信息论分解在颞上区域识别出领导者独有的预测信息以及一个独立的额极交互，在岛叶和额上区域识别出追随者独有的预测信息，在右侧前扣带皮层吻侧部发现稀疏的协同作用，并在多个皮层区域发现冗余。这些发现将二人组内的四元协调刻画为一种多尺度、角色不对称的架构，其中自上而下的预测控制和自下而上的适应性调节在功能上可分离。四元框架为这种分离提供了支架，其揭示的角色特异性特征可能为 interpersonal coordination 受损的临床人群提供候选生物标志物。

papers.title: Risk Omission and Limited Disclosure in Dietary Supplement Promotion by Social Media Influencers
papers.translated_title: 社交媒体影响者在膳食补充剂推广中的风险遗漏与有限披露
papers.author: Engel, E.
papers.summary: Importance: Dietary supplements carry risks including adverse effects, drug interactions, and contamination-related harms, yet are frequently marketed without premarket requirements for efficacy or safety. Social media influencers have become a primary source through which people encounter and make decisions about supplements, but whether they communicate clinically relevant risks alongside claimed benefits remains unclear. Objective: To investigate how dietary supplements are presented by Instagram influencers, focusing on supplement types, advertising disclosure, persuasive strategies, and communication of benefits and harms. Design, Setting, and Participants: Cross-sectional content analysis of 1,120 dietary supplement presentations in 727 Instagram posts by 84 influencer accounts identified through audience-centered purposive sampling from two independent youth-focused studies in Switzerland and Austria. Main Outcomes and Measures: Main outcomes were supplement types, overall tone, advertising disclosure, persuasive strategies, and communication of benefits and harms, all summarized descriptively. Logistic regression with cluster-robust standard errors assessed whether influencer type or supplement category influenced presentation characteristics. Results: Of 1,120 supplement presentations, 1092 (97.5%) were promotional in tone, 1088 (97.1%) involved advertising, but disclosure was absent in 802 advertisements (73.7%). Protein (463 [41.3%]), caffeine (156 [13.9%]), creatine (71 [6.3%]), and (multi-)vitamins (67 [6.0%]) were the most frequently identified ingredients. Benefits were mentioned in 269 presentations (24.0%); harms in only 26 (2.3%), mostly framing supplements as unnecessary or cautioning about side effects. No presentation mentioned drug interactions, contamination risks, or contraindications. Benefit claims were more common in presentations featuring micronutrient and miscellaneous ingredient supplements, and less common in presentations featuring sport nutrition supplements. Influencers with health credentials were more likely to include evidence cues than nonprofessionals (adjusted OR, 81.05; 95% CI, 13.76-477.44); associations with tone and personal experience narratives were not robust to adjustment. Conclusions and Relevance: Influencer presentation of supplements was highly commercialized, largely undisclosed, and characterized by a substantial imbalance between benefit and risk communication. The absence of clinically relevant risk information suggests that individuals relying on such content are unlikely to receive balanced safety information, underscoring the need for stronger regulation and proactive clinician inquiry about supplement use.
papers.translated_summary: 重要性：膳食补充剂存在风险，包括不良反应、药物相互作用和污染相关危害，但往往在上市前无需证明有效性或安全性即可营销。社交媒体影响者已成为人们接触补充剂并据此做出决策的主要渠道，但他们是否在宣传所称益处的同时传达临床相关风险仍不清楚。目的：调查Instagram影响者如何呈现膳食补充剂，重点关注补充剂类型、广告披露、说服策略以及益处与危害的传达。设计、设置和参与者：对来自瑞士和奥地利两项独立的以青年为中心的研究中，通过以受众为中心的目的性抽样确定的84个影响者账户的727条Instagram帖子中的1,120次膳食补充剂呈现进行横断面内容分析。主要结局和测量指标：主要结局为补充剂类型、整体基调、广告披露、说服策略以及益处与危害的传达，均以描述性方式总结。采用带聚类稳健标准误的逻辑回归评估影响者类型或补充剂类别是否影响呈现特征。结果：在1,120次补充剂呈现中，1092次（97.5%）基调为促销性，1088次（97.1%）涉及广告，但802条广告（73.7%）未作披露。蛋白质（463次[41.3%]）、咖啡因（156次[13.9%]）、肌酸（71次[6.3%]）和（多种）维生素（67次[6.0%]）是最常被识别的成分。269次呈现（24.0%）提及益处；仅26次（2.3%）提及危害，且多为将补充剂描述为不必要或警示副作用。没有任何呈现提及药物相互作用、污染风险或禁忌症。益处声明在以微量营养素及其他成分补充剂为特色的呈现中更为常见，在以运动营养补充剂为特色的呈现中较少见。具有健康资质的影响者比非专业人士更可能包含证据提示（调整后OR，81.05；95% CI，13.76-477.44）；与基调和个人经验叙事的关联在调整后不稳健。结论与相关性：影响者对补充剂的呈现高度商业化、大多未披露，且以益处与风险沟通的严重失衡为特征。临床相关风险信息的缺失表明，依赖此类内容的个人不太可能获得平衡的安全信息，这凸显了加强监管以及临床医生主动询问补充剂使用的必要性。

papers.title: Biological age uncertainty reveals discordant aging and predicts human healthspan
papers.translated_title: 生物学年龄的不确定性揭示了不一致的衰老并预测人类健康寿命
papers.author: Li, Y.
papers.summary: Biological aging clocks typically summarize complex biological profiles as a single age estimate, yet how uncertain these estimates are and whether this uncertainty represents a distinct, biologically meaningful dimension of human aging remain unclear. Here, we develop a probabilistic framework across nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) metabolomic, plasma proteomic and routine blood test (RBT) profiles in more than 450,000 UK Biobank participants to derive biological age gap (BAG) and biological age uncertainty (BAU) from the mean and width of predicted-age distributions. BAU was weakly correlated with BAG and increased with age-signal disagreement across individual molecules and organs, linking uncertainty to discordant aging across biological systems. Higher BAU predicted mortality, loss of healthspan and multimorbidity independently of BAG, with mortality hazard ratios of 1.24 (95% CI, 1.23-1.26) and 1.40 (95% CI, 1.37-1.43) per standard deviation for NMR- and proteomic-derived BAU, respectively. Adding BAU to conventional clinical models improved 10-year risk discrimination; moreover, longitudinal increases in NMR-derived BAU tracked subsequent health decline, and mortality associations were replicated using RBT-derived BAU across three independent external cohorts. Multi-omics and physiological analyses linked BAU to inflammation, metabolic dysregulation and tissue remodeling beyond BAG. Genetic analyses further revealed overlapping but distinct architectures of BAU and BAG, with BAU showing stronger genetic correlations with frailty and cardiometabolic diseases, and tissue and functional mapping implicating hepatic, immune and lipid-metabolic processes. This study establishes a framework for characterizing biological age through both its mean deviation and uncertainty, defining BAU as an independent dimension of human aging that links discordant aging to future healthspan.
papers.translated_summary: 生物学衰老时钟通常将复杂的生物学特征概括为单一的年龄估计值，但这些估计值的不确定性程度如何，以及这种不确定性是否代表了人类衰老中一个独特的、具有生物学意义的维度，目前仍不清楚。在此，我们构建了一个概率框架，应用于超过45万名英国生物银行参与者的核磁共振代谢组学、血浆蛋白质组学和常规血液检测特征，从预测年龄分布的均值和宽度推导出生物学年龄差距和生物学年龄不确定性。生物学年龄不确定性与生物学年龄差距相关性较弱，并随着单个分子和器官间年龄信号的不一致而增加，将不确定性与生物系统间的失调性衰老联系起来。较高的生物学年龄不确定性可独立于生物学年龄差距预测死亡率、健康寿命损失和多重疾病，核磁共振和蛋白质组学衍生的生物学年龄不确定性每增加一个标准差，死亡风险比分别为1.24（95%置信区间1.23-1.26）和1.40（95%置信区间1.37-1.43）。将生物学年龄不确定性加入传统临床模型可改善10年风险判别；此外，核磁共振衍生的生物学年龄不确定性的纵向增加追踪了随后的健康下降，且死亡关联在三个独立外部队列中使用常规血液检测衍生的生物学年龄不确定性得到了重复验证。多组学和生理学分析将生物学年龄不确定性与超越生物学年龄差距的炎症、代谢失调和组织重塑联系起来。遗传分析进一步揭示了生物学年龄不确定性与生物学年龄差距有重叠但不同的架构，生物学年龄不确定性显示出与衰弱和心血管代谢疾病更强的遗传相关性，组织和功能映射涉及肝脏、免疫和脂质代谢过程。本研究建立了一个通过均值偏差和不确定性来表征生物学年龄的框架，将生物学年龄不确定性定义为一个独立的人类衰老维度，将失调性衰老与未来的健康寿命联系起来。

papers.title: Treatment patterns and outcomes of pediatric rhabdomyosarcoma in a resource-limited setting: A retrospective study from a tertiary hospital in Ethiopia
papers.translated_title: 资源有限环境下儿童横纹肌肉瘤的治疗模式与结局：来自埃塞俄比亚一家三级医院的回顾性研究
papers.author: Semayneh, S. W.
papers.summary: Background: Rhabdomyosarcoma (RMS) is the most common pediatric soft tissue sarcoma. Despite excellent survival in high-income countries, data on treatment and outcomes remain limited in resource-limited settings. The aim of this study was to assess treatment patterns and survival outcomes of pediatric RMS in Ethiopia. Methods: We conducted a retrospective study of newly diagnosed pediatric RMS patients evaluated at Tikur Anbessa Specialized Hospital from January 2021 to September 2025. Data were extracted from medical records, and treatment patterns and survival were assessed using descriptive and Kaplan-Meier analyses. Results: A total of 94 pediatric patients with rhabdomyosarcoma were included. The median age at diagnosis was 4.0 years (IQR: 3.0-6.3 years). Of these patients, 23.4% were classified as low-risk, 61.7% as intermediate-risk, and 14.9% as high-risk. Multimodality treatment was delivered to 59.6% of patients, while 33.0% received chemotherapy alone and 7.4% received no treatment. At diagnosis, curative treatment intent was planned for 83% of patients, but only 71.8% ultimately received it. Treatment received varied by risk group: most (90.0%) low-risk patients got curative treatment, while only 64.3% of intermediate-risk patients got curative treatment intent. No high-risk patients received curative treatment.At a median follow-up of 21.0 months (95% CI: 17.6-24.4 months), median overall survival and event-free survival were 23.0 and 15.0 months, respectively. The 1-year and 2-year overall survival rates were 70% and 42%, respectively, while the corresponding event-free survival rates were 59% and 33%. In multivariable Cox regression, treatment modality (p < 0.001) and total chemotherapy cycles (p =0.001) remained independently associated with overall survival, while risk group was not significant (p =0.14). Conclusion: Pediatric rhabdomyosarcoma in Ethiopia presents with a high rate of high-risk disease. Multimodality therapy and completion of chemotherapy cycles are key determinants of improved survival. These findings highlight the urgent need for early detection, improved access to multimodal treatment, and strategies to reduce treatment abandonment and improve treatment completion rates in resource-limited settings. Larger prospective studies are warranted to validate these findings and guide evidence-based practice.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：横纹肌肉瘤（RMS）是儿童最常见的软组织肉瘤。尽管在高收入国家生存率良好，但在资源有限环境中关于治疗和结局的数据仍然有限。本研究旨在评估埃塞俄比亚儿童RMS的治疗模式和生存结局。方法：我们开展了一项回顾性研究，纳入2021年1月至2025年9月在Tikur Anbessa专科医院接受评估的新诊断儿童RMS患者。数据从病历中提取，采用描述性分析和Kaplan-Meier分析评估治疗模式和生存情况。结果：共纳入94例儿童横纹肌肉瘤患者。诊断时中位年龄为4.0岁（IQR：3.0-6.3岁）。其中23.4%被归类为低危，61.7%为中危，14.9%为高危。59.6%的患者接受了多模式治疗，33.0%仅接受化疗，7.4%未接受治疗。诊断时，83%的患者计划以治愈为治疗目的，但最终仅有71.8%接受了治愈性治疗。接受的治疗因风险组而异：大多数（90.0%）低危患者接受了治愈性治疗，而仅64.3%的中危患者接受了治愈性治疗意图。无高危患者接受治愈性治疗。在中位随访21.0个月（95% CI：17.6-24.4个月）时，中位总生存期和无事件生存期分别为23.0个月和15.0个月。1年和2年总生存率分别为70%和42%，相应的无事件生存率分别为59%和33%。在多变量Cox回归中，治疗模式（p < 0.001）和化疗总周期数（p = 0.001）仍与总生存期独立相关，而风险组无统计学意义（p = 0.14）。结论：埃塞俄比亚儿童横纹肌肉瘤呈现高危疾病比例高的特点。多模式治疗和完成化疗周期是改善生存的关键决定因素。这些发现凸显了在资源有限环境中早期发现、改善多模式治疗可及性以及制定减少治疗放弃和提高治疗完成率策略的迫切需求。需要更大规模的前瞻性研究来验证这些发现并指导循证实践。

papers.title: Machine Learning Based Detection of Chronic Kidney Disease using Full Blood Count from a Ghanaian Hospital Population with an Integrated Web Application
papers.translated_title: 基于加纳医院人群全血细胞计数机器学习的慢性肾病检测及集成网络应用
papers.author: Akwetey, B. Y.
papers.summary: Chronic kidney disease (CKD) is usually silent until advanced, and the tests confirming it are frequently unaffordable in sub-Saharan Africa, whereas the full blood count (FBC) is inexpensive and widely performed. We assessed whether machine learning applied to the FBC can detect CKD, and how far its reported performance depends on where synthetic minority oversampling (SMOTE) is applied. Records of 155 patients at the Ho Technical University Hospital, Ghana, 43 (27.7%) with CKD, yielded ten features: age, cardiovascular disease and eight raw FBC parameters. Eleven algorithms, six resampling strategies and thirteen ensembles were compared under repeated stratified cross-validation. With SMOTE applied before the train-test split, the protocol under which the deployed models were fitted, Random Forest and Extra Trees both reached an accuracy of 83.9%, with sensitivities of 0.893 and 0.857 and areas under the curve (AUC) of 0.925 and 0.939; repeated cross-validation gave an accuracy of 0.809 {+/-} 0.051 and an AUC of 0.897. With resampling confined to the training folds, the same features gave a held-out accuracy of 61.5% and an AUC of 0.604 in 39 unseen patients. Age was the only variable separating the groups after correction for multiple testing (median 64 versus 47 years, adjusted p = 0.0026). The models are deployed as NephroScan GH (https://nephroscangh.com), which explains every prediction. The FBC carries a real but moderate signal for CKD, and the 22.4 point gap between the two protocols quantifies how far a single preprocessing decision can move a reported accuracy.
papers.translated_summary: 慢性肾脏病（CKD）通常在进展至晚期前无明显症状，而确诊所需的检查在撒哈拉以南非洲往往难以负担，相比之下，全血细胞计数（FBC）价格低廉且广泛开展。我们评估了将机器学习应用于FBC能否检测CKD，以及其所报告的性能在多大程度上取决于合成少数类过采样（SMOTE）的应用位置。加纳霍技术大学医院155名患者的记录中，43名（27.7%）患有CKD，提取了十个特征：年龄、心血管疾病及八项原始FBC参数。在重复分层交叉验证下比较了十一种算法、六种重采样策略和十三种集成方法。在训练-测试划分之前应用SMOTE（即部署模型所采用的拟合方案）时，随机森林和极端随机树均达到83.9%的准确率，灵敏度分别为0.893和0.857，曲线下面积（AUC）分别为0.925和0.939；重复交叉验证给出的准确率为0.809 {+/-} 0.051，AUC为0.897。将重采样限制在训练折内时，相同特征在39名未见患者中给出的留出准确率为61.5%，AUC为0.604。经多重检验校正后，年龄是唯一区分两组的变量（中位数64岁对47岁，校正p = 0.0026）。这些模型已部署为NephroScan GH（https://nephroscangh.com），可对每个预测进行解释。FBC对CKD携带真实但中等强度的信号，两种方案之间22.4个百分点的差距量化了单一预处理决策能使所报告的准确率偏移多远。

papers.title: Baseline Physical Activity Guideline Attainment and Mortality Across Cardiovascular-Kidney-Metabolic Syndrome Stages
papers.translated_title: 不同心血管-肾脏-代谢综合征阶段基线体力活动指南达标情况与死亡率
papers.author: Luo, X.
papers.summary: Background The 2023 American Heart Association cardiovascular-kidney-metabolic (CKM) staging framework supports risk stratification, but evidence on guideline-level physical activity across stages remains limited. Methods We emulated a target-trial protocol using NHANES 2007-2018 and National Death Index linkage through December 31, 2019. Adults aged 20 to 79 years with CKM stages 1 to 4, estimated glomerular filtration rate of at least 15 mL/min/1.73 m2, complete activity data, no cancer history, and eligible follow-up were included. Baseline activity was classified as meeting or not meeting the guideline. Within-stage propensity-score weights were used in weighted Cox models. All-cause and cardiovascular mortality were the primary and secondary outcomes; 5-year risks used weighted survival curves, with competing-risk cumulative incidence also estimated for cardiovascular mortality. Results Among 19,654 participants, 1,190 all-cause deaths occurred during 134,037 person-years. Baseline attainment was associated with lower all-cause mortality overall (HR, 0.774; 95% CI, 0.675-0.888). Stage-specific HRs were 1.030, 0.803, 0.642, and 0.727 for stages 1 to 4, respectively; estimates were nonmonotonic. Five-year risk differences were +0.040, -0.830, -1.790, and -3.840 percentage points; only the stage 4 interval excluded the null. Cardiovascular mortality showed a similar overall cause-specific association (HR, 0.707; 95% CI, 0.547-0.914). Conclusions Observed baseline guideline attainment was associated with mortality in this observational target-trial emulation. The findings are consistent with current physical activity recommendations but do not estimate the effect of an activity-promotion intervention; prospective trials are needed to establish clinical benefit.
papers.translated_summary: 背景 2023年美国心脏协会心血管-肾脏-代谢（CKM）分期框架支持风险分层，但关于指南水平身体活动在各分期中的证据仍然有限。方法 我们使用NHANES 2007-2018及截至2019年12月31日的国家死亡指数 linkage 数据，模拟了一项目标试验方案。纳入20至79岁、CKM分期1至4期、估算肾小球滤过率至少15 mL/min/1.73 m2、活动数据完整、无癌症病史且随访符合条件的成年人。基线活动被分类为符合或不符合指南。在加权Cox模型中使用分期内倾向评分权重。全因死亡和心血管死亡为主要和次要结局；5年风险使用加权生存曲线，其中心血管死亡还估计了竞争风险累积发生率。结果 在19,654名参与者中，134,037人年随访期间发生1,190例全因死亡。基线达标总体上与较低的全因死亡率相关（HR，0.774；95% CI，0.675-0.888）。1至4期的分期特异性HR分别为1.030、0.803、0.642和0.727；估计值呈非单调性。5年风险差异分别为+0.040、-0.830、-1.790和-3.840个百分点；仅第4期的区间排除了无效值。心血管死亡显示出相似的总体病因特异性关联（HR，0.707；95% CI，0.547-0.914）。结论 在这项观察性目标试验模拟中，观察到的基线指南达标与死亡率相关。研究结果与当前身体活动建议一致，但并未估计活动促进干预的效果；需要前瞻性试验来确定临床获益。

papers.title: Non-contact fingertip video to differentiate dengue haemorrhagic fever in plasma leakage from dengue fever: A prospective proof-of-concept cohort study
papers.translated_title: 非接触式指尖视频用于区分登革出血热血浆渗漏与登革热：一项前瞻性概念验证队列研究
papers.author: Perera, M. H. M. T. S.
papers.summary: Most patients with dengue recover without intervention, but a minority develop plasma leakage that threatens the circulation, and differentiating them is the central problem in dengue care. Platelet count is the marker in routine serial use and is itself one of the four defining criteria of dengue haemorrhagic fever (DHF), so thrombocytopenia in dengue fever (DF) can overlap with DHF on the very marker used to distinguish them. We asked whether a non-contact optical signal carries discriminative information beyond platelet count. We conducted a prospective observational cohort study at a national dengue referral centre. All DHF recordings were obtained at or after plasma-leakage onset, so the analysis compares established clinical states rather than pre-leakage risk. Serial non-contact fingertip videos were recorded with contemporaneous clinical and haematological measurements. In a held-out set of 50 recordings (20 DHF, 30 DF), video-derived probability separated the groups with an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.963 (95% CI 0.918-1.000; 0.957 averaged across eight architectures). In the 49 recordings with a platelet count, the video AUC was 0.961 against 0.888 for platelet count (difference 0.074, p = 0.19). In exploratory analyses the video added information to platelet count (likelihood-ratio p < 0.001), showed no significant within-group correlation with platelet count, and retained an AUC of 0.970 against thrombocytopenic DF, where platelet count fell to 0.759. Bedside pulse rate, body temperature and haematocrit did not separate the groups and were unrelated to the video score. A ~30-second fingertip video separated DHF in plasma leakage from DF in this test set, and exploratory analyses suggest it carries information beyond platelet count. These findings are proof of concept from single-centre internal validation, not evidence of pre-leakage prediction; prospective pre-leakage studies and external validation are needed to establish whether the signal can support earlier risk stratification.
papers.translated_summary: 大多数登革热患者无需干预即可康复，但少数患者会出现威胁循环的血浆渗漏，区分二者是登革热诊疗的核心问题。血小板计数是常规连续使用的标志物，其本身也是登革出血热（DHF）四项定义标准之一，因此登革热（DF）中的血小板减少可在用于区分二者的同一标志物上与DHF重叠。我们探究了非接触式光学信号是否携带超越血小板计数的判别信息。我们在一个国家登革热转诊中心开展了一项前瞻性观察队列研究。所有DHF记录均在血浆渗漏发生当时或之后获得，因此分析比较的是已确立的临床状态，而非渗漏前风险。连续非接触式指尖视频与同期临床和血液学测量一同记录。在50份记录（20份DHF，30份DF）的留出集中，视频衍生的概率区分两组，受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）为0.963（95% CI 0.918-1.000；八种架构平均为0.957）。在49份有血小板计数的记录中，视频AUC为0.961，血小板计数为0.888（差异0.074，p = 0.19）。在探索性分析中，视频为血小板计数增加了信息（似然比p < 0.001），与血小板计数无显著组内相关性，并且在针对血小板减少性DF时保持AUC为0.970，而血小板计数降至0.759。床旁脉率、体温和血细胞比容未能区分两组，且与视频评分无关。约30秒的指尖视频在该测试集中将血浆渗漏期的DHF与DF区分开来，探索性分析提示其携带超越血小板计数的信息。这些发现是单中心内部验证的概念验证，并非渗漏前预测的证据；需要前瞻性渗漏前研究和外部验证来确定该信号能否支持更早期的风险分层。

papers.title: Prevalence, Awareness and Correlates of Self-Reported Hypoglycemia Among Adults with Type 2 Diabetes in Northern Jordan: A Cross-Sectional Study
papers.translated_title: 约旦北部2型糖尿病成人自我报告低血糖的患病率、知晓率及相关因素：一项横断面研究
papers.author: Khasawneh, A.
papers.summary: Hypoglycemia is a frequent and potentially dangerous adverse effect of glucose-lowering therapy in type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM), yet data on its prevalence, patient awareness and correlates in Jordan are limited. We conducted a cross-sectional study of 326 adults with T2DM attending family medicine outpatient clinics at a tertiary teaching hospital (King Abdullah University Hospital, KAUH) and a university-affiliated primary healthcare center (JUST PHC) in northern Jordan between 2025 and 2026. Trained interviewers administered a structured questionnaire, and laboratory results were verified from electronic medical records. Hypoglycemia was defined as a glucose level below 70 mg/dL or symptoms relieved by fast-acting carbohydrate during the preceding six months. Prevalence was estimated with 95% confidence intervals, and associated factors were examined using chi-square tests and multivariable logistic regression. The prevalence of self-reported hypoglycemia was 79.1% (258/326; 95% CI 74.4-83.2). Although 71.5% of participants knew the symptoms of hypoglycemia, 73.9% were unaware that it can occur without symptoms, 53.6% had never reported an episode to a healthcare provider, only 31.3% had discussed hypoglycemia risk with a physician, and 50.6% never carried sugar or an emergency kit. In the multivariable model, insulin use (adjusted odds ratio [aOR] 3.27, 95% CI 1.75-6.10), sulfonylurea use (aOR 2.14, 1.18-3.87), diabetic nephropathy (aOR 3.76, 1.05-13.48) and attending the primary healthcare center versus the hospital (aOR 2.76, 1.42-5.36) were independently associated with higher odds of hypoglycemia, whereas beta-blocker use was associated with lower odds (aOR 0.52, 0.28-0.95). Self-reported hypoglycemia was highly prevalent among patients with T2DM in northern Jordan, and awareness of asymptomatic hypoglycemia and reporting to providers were limited. Routine structured enquiry about hypoglycemia, patient education that addresses asymptomatic episodes, and review of high-risk therapy, particularly in primary care, are warranted.
papers.translated_summary: 低血糖是2型糖尿病（T2DM）降糖治疗中常见且可能具有危险性的不良反应，然而关于其在约旦的患病率、患者认知及相关因素的数据仍然有限。我们于2025年至2026年间在约旦北部一家三级教学医院（阿卜杜拉国王大学医院，KAUH）和一家大学附属初级卫生保健中心（JUST PHC）的家庭医学门诊开展了一项横断面研究，纳入326名成年T2DM患者。由经过培训的访谈员实施结构化问卷，并从电子病历中核实实验室结果。低血糖定义为过去六个月内血糖水平低于70 mg/dL或出现经快速起效碳水化合物缓解的症状。采用95%置信区间估计患病率，并通过卡方检验和多因素logistic回归分析相关因素。自我报告低血糖的患病率为79.1%（258/326；95% CI 74.4-83.2）。尽管71.5%的参与者了解低血糖症状，但73.9%不知道低血糖可在无症状情况下发生，53.6%从未向医疗保健提供者报告过低血糖发作，仅31.3%曾与医生讨论过低血糖风险，50.6%从不携带糖或急救包。在多因素模型中，胰岛素使用（调整比值比[aOR] 3.27，95% CI 1.75-6.10）、磺脲类药物使用（aOR 2.14，1.18-3.87）、糖尿病肾病（aOR 3.76，1.05-13.48）以及在初级卫生保健中心而非医院就诊（aOR 2.76，1.42-5.36）与低血糖发生几率升高独立相关，而β受体阻滞剂使用与较低几率相关（aOR 0.52，0.28-0.95）。在约旦北部的T2DM患者中，自我报告低血糖的患病率很高，对无症状低血糖的认知及向提供者报告的比例有限。有必要常规开展针对低血糖的结构化询问、涵盖无症状发作的患者教育以及高风险治疗方案的审查，尤其是在初级保健环境中。

papers.title: Antimicrobial resistance patterns among urinary isolates from long-term care residents in Canada: findings from an AMRNet pilot
papers.translated_title: 加拿大长期护理机构居民尿液分离株的抗菌药物耐药模式：AMRNet试点研究结果
papers.author: Yadav, C.
papers.summary: Background: Antimicrobial resistance is a growing concern in long-term care facilities (LTCs), where residents are often older, have chronic health conditions, and are frequently prescribed antimicrobials. Historically, antimicrobial resistance data from Canadian LTCs have been limited. This study explores the use of lab-based surveillance data from the Public Health Agency of Canada's AMRNet program to describe antimicrobial resistance in LTCs. Methods: Antimicrobial susceptibility data for clinical bacterial specimens were submitted from public and private laboratories across Canada. Where feasible, LTC patients were identified by submitting jurisdictions. Data on urinary isolates from identified LTC patients were analysed using the first isolate per patient per species per calendar year. The data were described by distribution of age group, sex, species and antimicrobial susceptibility. Antimicrobials were classified by the World Health Organization's 'Access, Watch and Reserve' (AWaRe) framework and a weighted-incidence syndromic combination antibiogram was constructed. As part of AMRNet program development, in some jurisdictions, only certain specimen types or organisms were submitted. Not all jurisdictions participated every year. Due to privacy precautions, some values rely on estimations. Results: From 2016-2024, AMRNet received data on 216,524 isolates from five provinces (BC, NL, ON, PEI, SK). Most isolates (98%) were from patients aged >=60, with those >=80 years representing 80%; females predominated across all age groups. Urine represented >99% of submitted data. The most common organisms identified from urinary isolates were Escherichia coli (51%), Klebsiella pneumoniae (14%) and Proteus mirabilis (12%). Non susceptibility varied across organisms: E. coli demonstrated higher non-susceptibility to several commonly used agents including fluoroquinolones (44%) and third generation cephalosporins (18%) while K. pneumoniae displayed high non-susceptibility to nitrofurantoin (56%). Among P. mirabilis, 26% were non susceptible to ciprofloxacin. Aminoglycoside and carbapenem resistance were low. When antimicrobials were grouped by WHO AWaRe categories, more than half of E. coli isolates were non-susceptible to at least one Watch antimicrobial. Interpretation: AMRNet lab-based surveillance data can help describe national AMR patterns among LTC residents. Although limitations exist and identifying LTC patients in lab-based datasets can be challenging in some jurisdictions, these data provide a feasible and cost-effective means of tracking national resistance trends among an at-risk population.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：抗微生物药物耐药性在长期护理机构（LTCs）中日益受到关注，这些机构的居民通常年龄较大、患有慢性健康问题，并且经常被处方抗微生物药物。历史上，来自加拿大长期护理机构的抗微生物药物耐药性数据有限。本研究探讨利用加拿大公共卫生署AMRNet项目的实验室监测数据来描述长期护理机构中的抗微生物药物耐药性。方法：来自加拿大各地公共和私人实验室的临床细菌标本抗微生物药物敏感性数据被提交。在可行的情况下，通过提交数据的辖区识别长期护理机构患者。对已识别长期护理机构患者的尿液分离株数据进行分析，采用每位患者每种菌种每个日历年第一株分离株的方法。数据按年龄组、性别、菌种和抗微生物药物敏感性分布进行描述。抗微生物药物按世界卫生组织“可及、慎用和储备”（AWaRe）框架分类，并构建了加权发病率综合征组合抗菌谱。作为AMRNet项目开发的一部分，在一些辖区仅提交特定标本类型或微生物。并非所有辖区每年都参与。由于隐私保护措施，部分数值依赖估算。结果：2016年至2024年，AMRNet收到来自五个省份（不列颠哥伦比亚省、纽芬兰与拉布拉多省、安大略省、爱德华王子岛省、萨斯喀彻温省）的216,524株分离株数据。大多数分离株（98%）来自年龄≥60岁的患者，其中≥80岁者占80%；女性在所有年龄组中均占多数。尿液占提交数据的99%以上。尿液分离株中最常见的微生物为大肠埃希菌（51%）、肺炎克雷伯菌（14%）和奇异变形杆菌（12%）。非敏感性因微生物而异：大肠埃希菌对几种常用药物表现出较高的非敏感性，包括氟喹诺酮类（44%）和第三代头孢菌素（18%），而肺炎克雷伯菌对呋喃妥因表现出高非敏感性（56%）。在奇异变形杆菌中，26%对环丙沙星非敏感。氨基糖苷类和碳青霉烯类耐药率较低。当抗微生物药物按WHO AWaRe类别分组时，超过半数的大肠埃希菌分离株对至少一种慎用类抗微生物药物非敏感。解读：AMRNet实验室监测数据有助于描述长期护理机构居民中的国家抗微生物药物耐药性模式。尽管存在局限性，且在一些辖区从实验室数据集中识别长期护理机构患者可能具有挑战性，但这些数据为追踪高风险人群中的国家耐药趋势提供了一种可行且具有成本效益的手段。

papers.title: The relation of a blood DNA methylation score with six-year depression course and risk factors
papers.translated_title: 血液DNA甲基化评分与六年抑郁症病程及危险因素的关系
papers.author: Klose, D.
papers.summary: Background: DNA methylation (DNAm) signatures of major depressive disorder (MDD) may be related to psychosocial, environmental, biological, and lifestyle risks. We tested a blood-based DNAm depression score (MD-MS) based on an existing EWAS (N = 24,754) in N = 731 individuals for predicting 8 clinical and 16 MDD risk factors and whether different MDD trajectories mapped to changes in MD-MS over six years. Methods: We calculated the MD-MS based on the top 15 strongest, epigenome-wide significant depression associated sites from the largest EWAS to date in EPICv2-profiled blood samples from N = 366 NESDA participants at baseline and N = 365 at six-year follow-up (FU6). Sixty percent of participants obtained a lifetime MDD diagnosis before or during the study timeframe. Linear mixed effect models were used for all analyses. Results: The MD-MS was elevated in lifetime MDD vs. controls ({beta}=0.137, p=0.012). Lower social activity ({beta}=0.051, p=0.043), CRP ({beta}=0.068, p=0.006), triglycerides ({beta}=0.055, p=0.036) and fasting glucose ({beta}=0.059, p=0.025) showed positive associations with MD-MS, while higher neighborhood air pollution levels showed a negative association ({beta}=-0.054, p=0.031). Adjustment for psychosocial variables (social activity, childhood trauma, partner status) attenuated the MD-MS association with lifetime MDD by 17.5% ({beta}=0.114, p=0.051). Longitudinally, individuals with chronic MDD exhibited consistently higher MD-MS compared to controls ({beta} = 0.295, p = 0.001). Conclusions: The MD-MS captures an epigenetic signature of lifetime exposure to MDD. The significant influences of psychosocial and biological factors on this association, although of limited effect size, warrant further research on potentially actionable mechanisms against aberrant depression-related DNAm patterns.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：重度抑郁症（MDD）的DNA甲基化（DNAm）特征可能与心理社会、环境、生物学和生活方式风险相关。我们在N=731名个体中，基于现有的一项EWAS（N=24,754）测试了基于血液的DNAm抑郁评分（MD-MS），用于预测8项临床因素和16项MDD风险因素，以及不同的MDD轨迹是否对应六年内MD-MS的变化。方法：我们基于迄今最大EWAS中前15个最强的、全表观基因组显著抑郁相关位点计算MD-MS，样本为N=366名NESDA参与者在基线和N=365名在六年随访（FU6）时的EPICv2分型血液样本。60%的参与者在研究时间框架之前或期间获得过终生MDD诊断。所有分析均使用线性混合效应模型。结果：与对照组相比，终生MDD患者的MD-MS升高（{beta}=0.137，p=0.012）。较低的社会活动（{beta}=0.051，p=0.043）、CRP（{beta}=0.068，p=0.006）、甘油三酯（{beta}=0.055，p=0.036）和空腹血糖（{beta}=0.059，p=0.025）与MD-MS呈正相关，而较高的社区空气污染水平呈负相关（{beta}=-0.054，p=0.031）。对心理社会变量（社会活动、童年创伤、伴侣状况）的调整使MD-MS与终生MDD的关联减弱了17.5%（{beta}=0.114，p=0.051）。在纵向上，慢性MDD个体与对照组相比表现出持续较高的MD-MS（{beta} = 0.295，p = 0.001）。结论：MD-MS捕捉了终生暴露于MDD的表观遗传特征。心理社会和生物学因素对这一关联的显著影响，尽管效应量有限，值得进一步研究针对异常抑郁相关DNAm模式的潜在可干预机制。

papers.title: Sexual identity and seeking mental healthcare in young adults: A national cohort study
papers.translated_title: 性身份与年轻人寻求心理保健：一项全国队列研究
papers.author: Khanolkar, A.
papers.summary: Aim: Most evidence on sexual minority health focuses on quantifying mental health inequalities with limited evidence on differences in accessing and receiving mental healthcare. This study examined associations between sexual identity and self-reported seeking and receiving mental healthcare in young adults from a population-based cohort study. Methods: 12,782 individuals (22% LGBQ+) aged 23 from the UK wide Millennium Cohort Study. Associations between sexual identity (heterosexual [reference category], mainly heterosexual, gay/lesbian and other sexual identities[LGBQ+]) assessed at age 17 and seeking mental healthcare were examined using multivariable logistic regression with sequential adjustment for sociodemographic factors (sex/ethnicity/SES), past (ages 14-17) and current (age 23) mental health, victimisation, loneliness and social support. Associations between sexual identity and receiving mental healthcare at age 23 was examined using multivariable logistic regression among those who sought help. Predicted probabilities were estimated from logistic models for interpretation. Results: All LGBQ+ groups had higher odds of seeking mental healthcare than heterosexuals. In the minimally-adjusted model, predicted probability of seeking care was lowest for heterosexual (24%), highest for bisexual (45%) and gay/lesbian individuals (49%). These significant differences attenuated but persisted in fully adjusted models, narrowing the probability gap between heterosexual and LGBQ+ groups from 25% to 10%. Furthermore, mental health history independently predicted help-seeking behaviour at age 23 among heterosexuals; but not in LGBQ+ groups. Among individuals seeking support, LGBQ+ groups had higher odds of receiving care than heterosexual peers, with highest baseline probabilities observed in the other sexual identity group (35% vs 15%). These differences remained largely unchanged after adjustment. Conclusion: LGBQ+ groups face substantial disparities, demonstrating significantly higher odds of both seeking and receiving mental healthcare than heterosexual peers. Crucially, the elevated rates of receiving care persist after full adjustment, indicating that these inequalities remain largely independent of downstream mediators and mental health history.
papers.translated_summary: 目的：关于性少数群体健康的大多数证据集中于量化心理健康不平等，而关于在获取和接受心理保健方面差异的证据有限。本研究基于一项人群队列研究，考察了性身份与年轻成年人自我报告寻求和接受心理保健之间的关联。方法：研究对象为来自英国全国千禧队列研究的12,782名23岁个体（22%为LGBQ+）。采用多变量逻辑回归，依次调整社会人口学因素（性别/族裔/社会经济地位）、过去（14-17岁）和当前（23岁）心理健康状况、受害经历、孤独感和社会支持，考察17岁时评估的性身份（异性恋[参照类别]、主要为异性恋、男同性恋/女同性恋及其他性身份[LGBQ+]）与寻求心理保健之间的关联。在寻求帮助者中，采用多变量逻辑回归考察性身份与23岁时接受心理保健之间的关联。预测概率由逻辑模型估计以便解释。结果：所有LGBQ+群体寻求心理保健的几率均高于异性恋者。在最低调整模型中，寻求保健的预测概率最低为异性恋者（24%），最高为双性恋者（45%）和男同性恋/女同性恋者（49%）。这些显著差异在完全调整模型中有所减弱但持续存在，异性恋者与LGBQ+群体之间的概率差距从25%缩小至10%。此外，心理健康史独立预测了异性恋者23岁时的求助行为，但在LGBQ+群体中则不然。在寻求支持者中，LGBQ+群体接受保健的几率高于异性恋同龄人，其他性身份群体的基线概率最高（35%对15%）。这些差异在调整后基本保持不变。结论：LGBQ+群体面临显著差异，其寻求和接受心理保健的几率均显著高于异性恋同龄人。关键在于，接受保健的较高比率在完全调整后仍然存在，表明这些不平等在很大程度上独立于下游中介因素和心理健康史。
